name: 等待事件分析诊断
description: PostgreSQL 的等待事件（wait_event_type + wait_event）揭示会话在等什么资源。分析等待事件可以定位性能瓶颈是在 CPU、I/O、锁、还是内部轻量锁。这是慢查询分析的重要补充。

conditions.desc: 超过 30% 的活跃会话在等待某种资源
超过 10 个会话在等待 I/O

skip_when.desc: 数据库空闲，无活跃查询
所有活跃会话状态正常（无等待）

root_causes.name: I/O 等待主导
root_causes.desc: 大量会话等待 DataFileRead/DataFileWrite/WALWrite 等 I/O 事件。通常是磁盘性能不足、shared_buffers 太小导致频繁磁盘读取、或 checkpoint 写入量过大。

root_causes.name: Lock 等待（行锁/表锁）
root_causes.desc: 会话等待 transactionid、relation、tuple 等锁。通常是长事务持锁、死锁、或高并发热点行竞争。

root_causes.name: LWLock 内部锁争用
root_causes.desc: WALWriteLock、BufferContent、BufferMapping 等轻量级锁争用。通常出现在高并发写入场景，与 WAL 刷盘频率和 shared_buffers 管理相关。

root_causes.name: Client 等待（应用端慢）
root_causes.desc: wait_event_type = 'Client' 且 wait_event = 'ClientRead/ClientWrite'。会话在等待客户端发送数据或接收结果。通常是应用端处理慢、网络延迟高、或结果集过大。

step1_wait_summary.sql: SELECT wait_event_type, wait_event, count(*) AS session_count FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state = 'active' AND wait_event IS NOT NULL GROUP BY wait_event_type, wait_event ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 20

step2_io_waits.sql: SELECT pid, usename, wait_event, LEFT(query, 80) AS query_prefix, now() - query_start AS runtime FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE wait_event_type = 'IO' AND state = 'active' ORDER BY query_start LIMIT 20

step3_lock_waits.sql: SELECT pid, usename, wait_event, LEFT(query, 80) AS query_prefix, now() - query_start AS runtime FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE wait_event_type = 'Lock' AND state = 'active' ORDER BY query_start LIMIT 20

step4_lwlock_waits.sql: SELECT pid, usename, wait_event, LEFT(query, 80) AS query_prefix, now() - query_start AS runtime FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE wait_event_type = 'LWLock' AND state = 'active' ORDER BY query_start LIMIT 20

step5_overall_activity.sql: SELECT state, wait_event_type, count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE backend_type = 'client backend' GROUP BY state, wait_event_type ORDER BY count(*) DESC

step1_wait_count.desc: 统计等待事件类型分布
step1_wait_count.sql: SELECT wait_event_type, COUNT(*) AS session_count FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state = 'active' AND wait_event IS NOT NULL GROUP BY wait_event_type ORDER BY session_count DESC

real_world_examples.scenario: 高峰期 60% 会话等待 DataFileRead
real_world_examples.symptoms: 下午 3 点并发上升后响应时间从 10ms 升到 500ms
real_world_examples.root_cause: shared_buffers=512MB 对 200GB 数据库太小，高峰期缓存命中率从 99% 降到 80%
real_world_examples.resolution: shared_buffers 增到 8GB，缓存命中率恢复到 99%
real_world_examples.result: IO 等待会话从 60% 降到 5%，P99 恢复到 15ms

real_world_examples.scenario: LWLock:buffer_content 等待导致 CPU 利用率低但响应慢
real_world_examples.symptoms: 数据库 CPU 只用 30% 但查询延迟 5 倍，pg_stat_activity 大量会话等待 LWLock:buffer_content
real_world_examples.root_cause: 多个会话并发更新同一热点页面，buffer content lock 争用严重
real_world_examples.resolution: 拆分热点表（分区或业务拆分），分散并发更新到不同页面
real_world_examples.result: LWLock 等待从 40% 降到 3%，查询延迟恢复正常
